info.title: Svaraa API
info.description:
Svaraa backend API.

**Authentication.** Sign in via `/auth/otp/verify` or `/auth/google` to get an access token, then send
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Use the **Authorize** button above to try protected endpoints.

**Tokens.** The access token lasts 3 days and the refresh token 5 years. Both carry `sub` = `<user_id>:<session_id>`.
When the access token expires, post the refresh token to `/auth/refresh` for a new access token. Logout ends the
session immediately, for both tokens.

**Errors** always have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`; branch on `code`, not `message`.

post.summary: Send myself a code to confirm a sensitive action
post.description: Sends an OTP to your own verified mobile number (60 second resend cooldown). Send it back as `otp` on the action: promoting a viewer to admin, approving an admin, demoting or removing an admin, releasing a device, transferring the caretaker or the wearer, or cancelling the circle. Five wrong codes an hour lock further attempts.

`wearer_first` (C1): creates the circle, makes you its wearer, and records consent in one step; the circle starts at `pending_pairing`. `caretaker_led` (D1): creates an empty `draft` with you as its admin. A user can be the wearer of one circle only, and an admin/viewer of at most 10.

post.description: Reserves the pendant for the circle (`claimed_unverified`); it is verified later, when the wearer pairs it. Caller must be the circle's wearer or an admin. Scanning again from the same circle is harmless. `409 device_already_claimed` means another circle holds it (screen E5): use `/devices/disputes` if it is yours. Up to 5 pendants per circle. **Mock codes:** in development and staging (never production) any code starting with `MOCK`, e.g. `MOCK-1`, creates a keyless mock pendant on the spot and claims it; each distinct code is a different pendant, and claiming the same one from another circle answers `device_already_claimed`. Pairing it verifies as `press_only`.

post.description: The circle must be `active`. A reminder needs a date **and** a time (`reminder_time_required`), the first occurrence must be at least 10 minutes (`reminder_too_soon`) and at most 90 days (`reminder_too_far_ahead`) from now, and a repeating one runs for at most 90 days (`reminder_runs_too_long`). A circle holds at most 50 active or paused reminders (`409 reminder_limit_reached`, with `details.limit` and `details.count`). Send `X-Timezone` (default `Asia/Kolkata`): `starts_at` is read in that zone and the reminder keeps it.

parameters.name: x-timezone

schema.description: The caller's IANA timezone, e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`. Local times in the request (a reminder's `starts_at`) are read in this zone. Defaults to `Asia/Kolkata` when absent; an unknown name is `400 invalid_timezone`.

get.summary: The times still to come, for the wearer's phone
get.description:
Poll this at least every 5 minutes. It lists when the circle's active reminders fire from now to `hours` ahead (default 48, at most 72), in order, in UTC, each with its text. Only the future is listed: a time that has passed is never shown, and nothing records whether it was done. Paused reminders are left out.

`version` changes whenever any reminder is added, edited, paused, resumed, deleted or ends. Send back the version you hold and you get `up_to_date: true` with no items. Do that only while the list you hold still reaches far enough ahead (say at least 24 hours), because the list moves forward with the clock even when no reminder changes; otherwise omit `version` to get the list again.

post.description:
Multipart form data with the recording in `audio` (m4a/aac, mp3, wav, webm, ogg, opus, flac, 3gp or amr; at most 50 MB). Answers at once with the note in `queued`; transcription and the notes (English and Hindi) follow in the background. Poll `GET /notes/{id}` every few seconds until `status` is `ready` or `failed`.

Send `duration_seconds` if you know it, so a recording over 2 hours is refused before upload work is done (`422 recording_too_long`). A user may upload 20 recordings a day (`429 notes_daily_limit_reached`, with `details.limit`).

Ask everyone being recorded for their agreement first: the app should say so before recording.

token.description: The box token, proving you hold the pendant's box

acknowledged_by.title: Acknowledged By
acknowledged_by.description: The circle member who acknowledged it

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Also returned in the x-request-id header

details.title: Details
details.description: Extras for some codes, e.g. `limit` and `count` on `reminder_limit_reached`

id_token.title: Id Token
id_token.description: ID token from native Google Sign-In on the device

next_action.title: Next Action
next_action.description: What this person should do next; null when nothing is needed

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Messages for the wearer and admins that replace push in v0, e.g. `wearer_declined`

pending_transfers.title: Pending Transfers
pending_transfers.description: Open caretaker or wearer handovers; the wearer can cancel any of them via `POST /transfers/{id}/cancel`

pending_members.title: Pending Members
pending_members.description: Wearer and admins only: people who redeemed an invite code and wait for approval

running_drill.description: A practice SOS waiting for an admin or viewer to acknowledge it

circles.title: Circles
circles.description: Empty until the user starts setup

InviteRefIn.title: InviteRefIn
InviteRefIn.description: Identify the invite by its token, or by `invite_id` from `GET /me/pending-invites` when the token was lost.

wearer_mobile_masked.title: Wearer Mobile Masked
wearer_mobile_masked.description: The number she must sign in with

LookupOut.title: LookupOut
LookupOut.description: Everything an unauthenticated holder of the link may learn: no wearer name, nothing private.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the person becomes once a wearer or admin approves them

code.title: Code
code.description: Shown only now; share it by message. Single use, valid 24 hours

status.description: `pending_approval` rows are only returned to the wearer and admins

otp.title: Otp
otp.description: Required to promote to admin or demote an admin

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page

status.title: Status
status.description: `queued` -> `transcribing` -> `summarizing` -> `ready`, or `failed`. A note being retried after an error is back in `queued` with `error` set

title.title: Title
title.description: The user's own title, if they set one. Else show `summary.<lang>.title`

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: When the recording started, as the app reported it

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Languages heard in the recording, e.g. ["hi", "en"]

error.description: Why the last attempt failed; null when nothing went wrong

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page

daily_limit.title: Daily Limit
daily_limit.description: How many recordings a user may upload per day (UTC)

status.title: Status
status.description: `queued` -> `transcribing` -> `summarizing` -> `ready`, or `failed`. A note being retried after an error is back in `queued` with `error` set

title.title: Title
title.description: The user's own title, if they set one. Else show `summary.<lang>.title`

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: When the recording started, as the app reported it

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Languages heard in the recording, e.g. ["hi", "en"]

error.description: Why the last attempt failed; null when nothing went wrong

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: The full text. "Speaker N: ..." lines when more than one person spoke

utterances.title: Utterances
utterances.description: The transcript in timed segments, with speakers

audio_available.title: Audio Available
audio_available.description: The recording is still stored (it is deleted after a few days)

title.title: Title
title.description: Null or blank goes back to the generated title

otp.title: Otp
otp.description: Required when the action grants or removes admin power

OtpIn.title: OtpIn
OtpIn.description: For actions that need the actor's own OTP. Get one from `POST /me/step-up`.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: Dialling code of the country, with or without +

mobile_number.title: Mobile Number
mobile_number.description: Mobile number without the country code

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.description: base64url. Pass it to the pendant, which signs it with its per-unit key

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds; the challenge is single use

requires_signature.title: Requires Signature
requires_signature.description: False for units without a per-unit key (press-only verification)

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature of the raw nonce bytes; required when `requires_signature`

installation_id.title: Installation Id
installation_id.description: From `POST /me/installations`; records this phone as the gateway

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Saving a name marks the profile completed

code.title: Code
code.description: Case and dashes do not matter

status.title: Status
status.description: Nothing is visible until a wearer or admin approves

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: Date **and time**, in the wearer's local time (a value with an offset is converted). A date alone is rejected with `reminder_time_required`. Must be at least 10 minutes and at most 90 days from now.

ends_on.title: Ends On
ends_on.description: Repeating reminders only: the last day it fires. At most 90 days after the first one; defaults to that limit.

repeat_until_confirmed.title: Repeat Until Confirmed
repeat_until_confirmed.description: Up to 3 times, 5 minutes apart, until the wearer says done

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: How many active or paused reminders a circle may have

count.title: Count
count.description: How many it has now (paused ones count)

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The zone `starts_at` was entered in. It fixes which local day a repeating reminder fires on; times below are UTC

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: The first possible time, in UTC (ends in `Z`). Convert it to the device's timezone to show it

ends_on.title: Ends On
ends_on.description: The last day (in `timezone`) a repeating reminder fires; null for a one-off

next_due_at.title: Next Due At
next_due_at.description: When it next fires, in UTC. Null when paused or finished

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Who created it; look the name up in the circle's members

ends_on.title: Ends On
ends_on.description: Send `null` to reset a repeating reminder to the longest allowed run (it always has an end date)

ReminderPatchIn.title: ReminderPatchIn
ReminderPatchIn.description: Only the fields you send change.

until.title: Until
until.description: Only for `interval`: the last time of day, from the time in `starts_at`

ReminderRuleIn.title: ReminderRuleIn
ReminderRuleIn.description: How often it repeats. The time of day comes from `starts_at`.

due_at.title: Due At
due_at.description: When to fire, in UTC. Key your alarm on `reminder_id` and `due_at`

repeat_until_confirmed.title: Repeat Until Confirmed
repeat_until_confirmed.description: Up to 3 times, 5 minutes apart, until the wearer says done: the phone's job

version.title: Version
version.description: Opaque. Changes whenever any reminder is added, edited, paused, resumed, deleted or ends

up_to_date.title: Up To Date
up_to_date.description: True when you sent this `version` back: `items` is empty and you keep what you hold

server_time.title: Server Time
server_time.description: UTC now on the server, to notice a clock that is off

window_end.title: Window End
window_end.description: The list covers from `server_time` to here, in UTC

items.title: Items
items.description: The times still to come, in order. Times that have passed are never listed

snapshot_hash.title: Snapshot Hash
snapshot_hash.description: From the last preview/draft response; consent is refused if the details changed since

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: If sent, replaces the whole contact list (up to 5)

url.title: Url
url.description: Put this in the share sheet. It is shown only now and cannot be fetched again

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the link stops working (72 hours)

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: True if this sign-in created the account

stream_url.title: Stream Url
stream_url.description: Temporary link to the audio (valid for a few hours). Empty if the song isn't playable yet.

from_user.title: From User
from_user.description: The admin handing over (or being replaced), or the current wearer

to_user.title: To User
to_user.description: Caretaker transfers: the member taking the seat

to_mobile_masked.title: To Mobile Masked
to_mobile_masked.description: Wearer transfers: the new wearer's number, masked

start.title: Start
start.description: Seconds from the start of the recording

mobile_number.title: Mobile Number
mobile_number.description: The new wearer's number; the setup link works only for it

url.title: Url
url.description: Share it with the new wearer. Shown only now. It works only for their number and lasts 72 hours
